## Teaching points

1. A regular ventricular rate near 150 should prompt a search for flutter waves.
2. Separate stability, rate control, stroke prevention and elective rhythm restoration into distinct decisions.
3. This patient has hypertension and diabetes, no reported major bleeding and normal renal function; anticoagulation is appropriate after assessment.
4. The case models slowing the ventricular response, not conversion to sinus rhythm.
